task: Write a Teams message to your colleague Sam (3–5 sentences). You are stuck in traffic and will be 20 minutes late for the stand-up. Say sorry and ask him to start without you.
zh: 给同事 Sam 写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。你堵在路上，站会要迟到 20 分钟。道歉，并请他先开始。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). You have to cancel dinner tonight because you must work late. Say sorry and suggest another day.
zh: 给朋友发一条短信（3–5 句）。你今晚要加班，得取消晚饭。道歉，并提议改到另一天。

task: Write a note to your flatmate (3–5 sentences). You used the last of their milk this morning. Say sorry and say when you will buy more.
zh: 给室友留一张便条（3–5 句）。你今天早上把他们的牛奶用完了。道歉，并说明你什么时候会再买。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). Ask her to review your pull request before lunch. Say what the change does and why it is a bit urgent.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。请她在午饭前审查你的 pull request。说明这个改动做了什么，以及为什么有点急。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). Ask to borrow their tent for a camping trip this weekend. Say when you will pick it up and when you will bring it back.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。想借他们的帐篷，这个周末去露营。说明什么时候去拿、什么时候还。

task: Text your landlord (3–5 sentences). The bathroom tap has been dripping for three days. Describe the problem and ask when someone can come to fix it.
zh: 给房东发短信（3–5 句）。浴室的水龙头已经滴水三天了。描述问题，并问什么时候能派人来修。

task: Post a short message in your team channel (3–5 sentences). The VPN is down. Tell people that IT is working on it and what they can do while they wait.
zh: 在团队频道发一条简短消息（3–5 句）。VPN 断了。告诉大家 IT 正在处理，以及等待期间可以怎么做。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). You found a great new dumpling place. Say what was good about it and invite them to go with you on Saturday.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。你发现了一家很棒的新饺子馆。说说好在哪里，并邀请他们周六一起去。

task: Write a note to your flatmate (3–5 sentences). A parcel is coming for you today and you will be out. Ask them to take it inside and say where to put it.
zh: 给室友留一张便条（3–5 句）。今天有你的包裹要到，但你不在家。请他们帮忙拿进来，并说明放在哪里。

task: Write a Teams message to your manager (3–5 sentences). You woke up with a bad cold. Say you will work from home today and what you plan to finish.
zh: 给经理写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。你早上醒来感冒很重。说明今天在家办公，以及打算完成哪些工作。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). Thank them for the birthday present they gave you. Say what it is and how you have used it already.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。感谢他们送你的生日礼物。说说礼物是什么，以及你已经怎么用了。

task: Text your neighbour (3–5 sentences). Their car is blocking your driveway and you need to leave at 8 am. Ask them politely to move it.
zh: 给邻居发短信（3–5 句）。他们的车挡住了你家车道，而你早上八点要出门。礼貌地请他们挪车。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). Ask him to cover your on-call shift on Friday night. Give your reason and offer to take one of his shifts.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。请他替你周五晚上的值班。说明原因，并提出替他值一次班作为交换。

task: Text your football team captain (3–5 sentences). You twisted your ankle and cannot play on Sunday. Say sorry and say when you hope to be back.
zh: 给足球队队长发短信（3–5 句）。你扭伤了脚踝，周日不能上场。道歉，并说说希望什么时候能回来。

task: Write a message to your flatmates' group chat (3–5 sentences). The power bill has arrived. Say the total, how much each person owes, and when to pay you.
zh: 在室友群里发一条消息（3–5 句）。电费账单到了。说明总金额、每人该付多少，以及什么时候转给你。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). You found a bug in his script. Tell him kindly, say what goes wrong, and offer to help fix it.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。你在他的脚本里发现了一个 bug。友好地告诉他，说明哪里出错，并表示愿意帮忙修。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). Ask if they can pick you up from the airport on Thursday night. Give your flight time and say how you will thank them.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。问他们周四晚上能不能来机场接你。告诉他们航班时间，并说你会怎么答谢。

task: Message a seller on Trade Me (3–5 sentences). Ask if the second-hand bike is still for sale. Ask one question about its condition and say when you could come to see it.
zh: 在 Trade Me 上给卖家发消息（3–5 句）。问那辆二手自行车还卖不卖。问一个关于车况的问题，并说你什么时候可以去看。

task: Write a Teams message to a new team member on her first day (3–5 sentences). Welcome her, say what you do in the team, and offer to take her for a coffee.
zh: 给第一天上班的新同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。欢迎她，介绍你在团队里做什么，并提出请她喝杯咖啡。

task: Text a friend who is waiting at the cinema (3–5 sentences). You are running ten minutes late. Ask them to buy the tickets and say you will pay them back.
zh: 给正在电影院等你的朋友发短信（3–5 句）。你要晚到十分钟。请他们先买票，并说你会把钱还给他们。

task: Write a note to your flatmate (3–5 sentences). You want to have four friends over on Saturday night. Ask if that is okay and promise to keep the noise down.
zh: 给室友留一张便条（3–5 句）。你想周六晚上请四个朋友来家里。问问是否可以，并保证不会太吵。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). Remind him that timesheets are due at 5 pm today. Be friendly, not bossy.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。提醒他工时表今天下午五点截止。语气要友好，不要像在命令人。

task: Text a friend who just failed their driving test (3–5 sentences). Cheer them up and offer to help them practise.
zh: 给刚刚没通过驾照考试的朋友发短信（3–5 句）。安慰鼓励他们，并提出陪他们练车。

task: Message your gym trainer (3–5 sentences). Your back hurts after yesterday's session. Say how it feels and ask which exercises you should do or avoid this week.
zh: 给健身教练发消息（3–5 句）。昨天上完课后你的背很疼。说说是什么感觉，并问这周应该做哪些动作、避免哪些动作。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). You cannot find the network diagram for the Wellington office. Ask where it is kept and say why you need it today.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。你找不到惠灵顿办公室的网络拓扑图。问它存在哪里，并说明为什么今天就需要。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). You have just sent them $40 for the concert ticket. Ask them to check their account and say you are looking forward to the show.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。你刚把演唱会门票的 40 块钱转给他们。请他们查一下账户，并说你很期待这场演出。

task: Write a note to your flatmate (3–5 sentences). The shower drain is blocked. Say what you have already tried and that you have called the property manager.
zh: 给室友留一张便条（3–5 句）。淋浴间的下水道堵了。说明你已经试过什么办法，并且已经联系了物业经理。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). She stayed late last night to help you finish the migration. Thank her and say exactly what her help made possible.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。她昨晚留下来帮你完成了迁移。感谢她，并具体说说她的帮助带来了什么结果。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). You loved the pavlova she made last weekend. Ask for the recipe and say when you want to make it.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。你很喜欢她上周末做的帕芙洛娃蛋糕。向她要食谱，并说你打算什么时候做。

task: Write a message to your sports team's group chat (3–5 sentences). Saturday's game is away in Hamilton. Ask who needs a ride and say how many seats you have in your car.
zh: 在球队群里发一条消息（3–5 句）。周六的比赛是在汉密尔顿的客场。问谁需要搭车，并说你车上有几个空位。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague (3–5 sentences). You cannot join her meeting at 2 pm because of another meeting. Say sorry and suggest two other times.
zh: 给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。下午两点你有别的会，参加不了她的会议。道歉，并提出两个别的时间。

task: Text a friend who just got a new job (3–5 sentences). Congratulate them, ask one question about the job, and suggest a way to celebrate.
zh: 给刚找到新工作的朋友发短信（3–5 句）。祝贺他们，问一个关于新工作的问题，并提议怎么庆祝一下。

task: Write a note to your flatmate (3–5 sentences). You will be away for a week. Ask them to water your plants and tell them how often.
zh: 给室友留一张便条（3–5 句）。你要出门一周。请他们帮忙给你的植物浇水，并告诉他们多久浇一次。

task: Write a Teams message to the office manager (3–5 sentences). The printer on level 2 keeps jamming. Say what happens and ask if someone can look at it.
zh: 给办公室经理写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。二楼的打印机老是卡纸。说明具体情况，并问能不能找人来看看。

task: Text a friend (3–5 sentences). You think you left your wallet at their house last night. Describe it and ask them to look on the couch.
zh: 给朋友发短信（3–5 句）。你觉得昨晚把钱包落在他们家了。描述一下钱包的样子，并请他们在沙发上找找。

task: Text your dentist's reception (3–5 sentences). You have had a toothache for two days. Describe the pain and ask for the earliest appointment.
zh: 给牙科诊所前台发短信（3–5 句）。你牙疼已经两天了。描述一下疼的情况，并问最早什么时候能约上。

task: Write a Teams message to a colleague after a meeting (3–5 sentences). You did not understand a short form people used, 'RCA'. Ask what it means and where you can read more.
zh: 会后给同事写一条 Teams 消息（3–5 句）。会上大家用的缩写“RCA”你没听懂。问问是什么意思，以及在哪里可以了解更多。

task: Text two friends (3–5 sentences). You want to drive to Rotorua for the long weekend. Suggest a leaving time and ask who can drive and who will book the place to stay.
zh: 给两个朋友发短信（3–5 句）。你想长周末开车去罗托鲁瓦。提议出发时间，并问谁能开车、谁来订住处。

task: Write a note to your flatmate (3–5 sentences). Their dirty dishes have been in the sink for three days. Ask them politely to wash them, without starting a fight.
zh: 给室友留一张便条（3–5 句）。他们的脏碗已经在水槽里放了三天。礼貌地请他们洗掉，不要引起争吵。

task: Post a message in your team channel (3–5 sentences). You are on leave all next week. Say who to contact for urgent problems and what you will finish before you go.
zh: 在团队频道发一条消息（3–5 句）。你下周整周休假。说明紧急问题该找谁，以及你走之前会完成什么。
